name: Minazuki Shiho
source:
A third-year student in the Japanese Music Department at Shukusei Music Academy. Her father is a famous potter and her mother is the head of the Minazuki school of tea ceremony, so she is a young lady born into a purely Japanese family. She
has a quiet and reserved personality. She always tries to keep herself one step behind others. She likes to wear clean clothes.

[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/19980701104740/http://www.elf-game.co.jp/special/syusaku/syusaku9.htm]the game's website, archived[/url]]
